description: Erection of an upward extension to create a two-storey house, erection of a replacement single storey rear extension, internal reconfiguration and all associated works including provision of landscaping and cycle storage.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings A002 and A003 (both amended), received 08/07/2022, Design, Access, Heritage and Planning Statement and Fire Statement, received 17/06/2022 and Drawing A001 -2D, Proposed/Existing Block/Location Plans and Site Photos, received 06/06/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (brickwork and roof tiles).
Condition : 4 - The first floor window formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
